Hi Olga / Marcus / Ava,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we liked the latency numbers and the routing options. Our internal compliance team needs a short walkthrough (SOC 2 scope, DPA review, and a pen-test expectations chat) to validate the integration and the evidence flow. - Evidence wishlist: I'll attach a concise checklist (see Redwood-evidence-wishlist-v1.pdf). It includes the controls we typically map and the log samples that help speed review.
- Proposed slots (all ET):
  • Wed 2026-11-18 14:00–15:15 ET (recommended)
  • Thu 2026-11-19 10:00–11:15 ET
  • Fri 2026-11-20 16:00–17:15 ET

Operational notes: please confirm the breakout participants (infra lead + one app engineer). We'll provide a short Ops runbook and a temporary read-only link to logs for the walkthrough. Also let us know if you need an NDA redline before we share the read-only data.

Attachments: Redwood-evidence-wishlist-v1.pdf (high level checklist + sample log names)
